title: 开发商评估办公楼计划
prompt: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Over-the-shoulder medium shot of two contemporary East Asian property developers at a plain planning table. They spread a large architectural floor plan beside a scale model of an ordinary twelve-storey rectangular office building and a calculator. One points at the land parcel and the other makes budget notes. Architectural plans and people dominate, not a skyscraper.
